commands: for f in skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md skills/review-and-fix/references/loop-control.md; do printf '%s  ' "$(python3 -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()).hexdigest())" "$f")"; echo "$f"; done

for f in skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md skills/review-and-fix/references/loop-control.md scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json; do git show pr-1305-head:$f | git hash-object --stdin >/dev/null; done
echo "=== sha256 at PR head ==="
git show pr-1305-head:skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md > .prflow/tmp/a1
git show pr-1305-head:skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md > .prflow/tmp/a2
git show pr-1305-head:skills/review-and-fix/references/loop-control. …[per-command-truncated]

git show pr-1305-head:skills/review-and-fix/SKILL.md > .prflow/tmp/a1
git show pr-1305-head:skills/review-and-fix/references/fixing.md > .prflow/tmp/a2
git show pr-1305-head:skills/review-and-fix/references/loop-control.md > .prflow/tmp/a3
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
names={".prflow/tmp/a1":"SKILL.md",".prflow/tmp/a2":"fixing.md",".prflow/tmp/a3":"loop-control.md"}
for f,n in names.items():
    print(hashlib.sha256(open(f,'rb').read()).hexdigest(), n)
